newsitem.title: USA: CBL & Associates buys mall for $86.4 mln.
newsitem.headline: CBL & Associates buys mall for $86.4 mln.

text.p: CBL & Associates Properties Inc on Monday said it bought St. Clair Square, a super mall in suburban St. Louis, from Prudential Real Estate Investors for $86.4 million.

To pay for the mall, CBL received a $66 million loan from Wells Fargo at about 6.75 percent -- or 150 basis points over LIBOR, with a three-year term and a two-year extension option. The balance of the cost the company paid with other loans, it said.
CBL expects mall operating operating income of about $7.7 million in 1997, it added.
The 1.04 million square foot mall sits on about 89 acres, and has several large department store tenants.
Built in 1974, the mall is 93.7 percent occupied and had sales of $329 per square foot for the year ended Dec 31, 1995.
